cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)

# This file is the only project-owned CMake file that knows the layout of the
# bundled dependency snapshots.  Keep the upstream projects themselves
# untouched and adapt their targets here.

function(dxx_add_target_alias alias target)
    if(TARGET "${target}" AND NOT TARGET "${alias}")
        add_library("${alias}" ALIAS "${target}")
    endif()
endfunction()

set(DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

# SDL 1.2 compatibility layer.  sdl12-compat is an SDL 1.2 ABI library that
# forwards to SDL2; the game still sees only the flat SDL 1.2 headers.
# Keep SDL2 shared: sdl12-compat and SDL2 have conflicting symbols if SDL2 is
# folded into the executable.  Only the SDL 1.2 compatibility layer is linked
# statically into the application.  The upstream CMake file only exposes its
# static compatibility target on Linux; the Windows adapter creates an
# equivalent target below.
set(SDL_SHARED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_STATIC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
# sdl12-compat loads this library by its ABI filename at runtime.
set(SDL_CMAKE_DEBUG_POSTFIX "" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL2_DISABLE_INSTALL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL2_DISABLE_UNINSTALL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(
    "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/sdl2"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/sdl2"
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
)

# sdl12-compat's CMake file searches for an installed SDL2 package.  Supply
# the headers generated by the bundled SDL2 build and disable that search so
# this path cannot accidentally mix bundled and system SDL2 artifacts.
set(SDL2_INCLUDE_DIRS
    "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/sdl2/include"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/sdl2/include"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/sdl2/include-config-$<LOWER_CASE:$<CONFIG>>/SDL2"
)
set(CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_SDL2 TRUE)
set(SDL12TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES "Linux")
    set(SDL12DEVEL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(STATICDEVEL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(_dxx_sdl_target SDL-static)
elseif(WIN32)
    # The upstream sdl12-compat CMake file only exposes its static target on
    # Linux, but the compatibility layer itself is also usable as a static
    # library on Windows.  Build that target locally below so the game does
    # not acquire an SDL.dll import.
    set(SDL12DEVEL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(STATICDEVEL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(_dxx_sdl_target dxx_sdl_static)
else()
    set(SDL12DEVEL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(STATICDEVEL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(_dxx_sdl_target SDL)
endif()
add_subdirectory(
    "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/sdl12-compat"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/sdl12-compat"
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
)

if(WIN32)
    add_library(dxx_sdl_static STATIC
        "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/sdl12-compat/src/SDL12_compat.c"
    )
    target_include_directories(dxx_sdl_static
        PRIVATE ${SDL2_INCLUDE_DIRS}
        PUBLIC
            "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/sdl12-compat/include>"
            "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/sdl12-compat/include/SDL>"
    )
    target_compile_definitions(dxx_sdl_static PRIVATE
        _REENTRANT
        SDL12_COMPAT_STATIC
    )
    if(TARGET SDL2)
        add_dependencies(dxx_sdl_static SDL2)
    endif()
endif()
unset(CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_SDL2)

if(TARGET ${_dxx_sdl_target})
    # SDL12-compat resolves SDL2 symbols with dlopen()/dlsym(); linking SDL2
    # here would defeat that boundary and reintroduce symbol collisions.
    if(TARGET SDL2)
        add_dependencies(${_dxx_sdl_target} SDL2)
    endif()
    target_include_directories(${_dxx_sdl_target} PUBLIC
        "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/sdl12-compat/include>"
        "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/sdl12-compat/include/SDL>"
    )
endif()
dxx_add_target_alias(thirdparty::sdl ${_dxx_sdl_target})
dxx_add_target_alias(thirdparty::sdlmain SDLmain)
target_compile_definitions(SDLmain PRIVATE SDL12_COMPAT_STATIC)

# PhysicsFS is already CMake-native.  Build only the static library; tests,
# utilities, shared libraries, and install rules are not part of the game
# build.
set(PHYSFS_BUILD_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PHYSFS_BUILD_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PHYSFS_BUILD_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PHYSFS_BUILD_DOCS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PHYSFS_DISABLE_INSTALL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PHYSFS_TARGETNAME_DIST dxx_physfs_dist CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(PHYSFS_TARGETNAME_UNINSTALL dxx_physfs_uninstall CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(
    "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/physfs-main"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/physfs"
    EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
)
dxx_add_target_alias(thirdparty::physfs physfs-static)

if(PNG)
    # libpng's CMake project consumes the conventional ZLIB::ZLIB target.
    set(ZLIB_BUILD_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ZLIB_BUILD_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ZLIB_BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ZLIB_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory(
        "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/zlib/src/v1.3.2-c19a0bfd23.clean"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/zlib"
        EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
    )
    if(TARGET zlibstatic AND NOT TARGET ZLIB::ZLIB)
        add_library(ZLIB::ZLIB ALIAS zlibstatic)
    endif()
    dxx_add_target_alias(thirdparty::zlib zlibstatic)

    # FindZLIB otherwise prefers the host copy when libpng configures its
    # generated pnglibconf.h.  Keep the header version and library target on
    # the same bundled zlib snapshot.
    set(ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR
        "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/zlib/src/v1.3.2-c19a0bfd23.clean"
        CACHE PATH "" FORCE
    )
    if(WIN32)
        set(_dxx_zlib_static_suffix s)
    else()
        set(_dxx_zlib_static_suffix)
    endif()
    set(ZLIB_LIBRARY
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/zlib/${CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_PREFIX}z${_dxx_zlib_static_suffix}${CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}"
        CACHE FILEPATH "" FORCE
    )
    set(ZLIB_USE_STATIC_LIBS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

    set(PNG_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(PNG_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(PNG_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(PNG_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(SKIP_INSTALL_ALL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory(
        "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/libpng/src/v1.6.58-b91136795d"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/libpng"
        EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
    )
    dxx_add_target_alias(thirdparty::png png_static)
endif()

if(OPENGL)
    # The vendored GLEW snapshot does not ship a CMake project, so provide a
    # small target with the same usage requirements as the upstream static
    # library.  Its public GLEW_STATIC definition is required by glew.h.
    set(_dxx_glew_root "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/glew/src/glew-8cf78e348c")
    add_library(dxx_glew STATIC "${_dxx_glew_root}/src/glew.c")
    target_compile_definitions(dxx_glew PUBLIC GLEW_STATIC)
    target_include_directories(dxx_glew PUBLIC
        "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${_dxx_glew_root}/include>"
    )
    dxx_add_target_alias(thirdparty::glew dxx_glew)
endif()

if(SDLMIXER)
    # Build Ogg and Vorbis from the bundled sources.  libvorbis' upstream
    # CMake wrapper requires find_package(Ogg), so seed its lookup with the
    # bundled target's include and output paths before adding libvorbis.
    set(_dxx_build_shared_libs_was_defined FALSE)
    if(DEFINED BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
        set(_dxx_build_shared_libs_was_defined TRUE)
        set(_dxx_build_shared_libs_saved "${BUILD_SHARED_LIBS}")
    endif()
    cmake_policy(PUSH)
    cmake_policy(SET CMP0077 NEW)
    set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
    set(INSTALL_DOCS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(INSTALL_PKG_CONFIG_MODULE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(INSTALL_CMAKE_PACKAGE_MODULE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory(
        "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/libogg/src/v1.3.6-4ad11a7327"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/libogg"
        EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
    )
    dxx_add_target_alias(thirdparty::ogg ogg)

    set(OGG_INCLUDE_DIR
        "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/libogg/src/v1.3.6-4ad11a7327/include"
        CACHE PATH "" FORCE
    )
    set(OGG_LIBRARY
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/libogg/${CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_PREFIX}ogg${CMAKE_STATIC_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}"
        CACHE FILEPATH "" FORCE
    )
    add_subdirectory(
        "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/libvorbis/src/v1.3.7-c32164610e"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/libvorbis"
        EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
    )
    set(_dxx_skip_install_rules_was_defined FALSE)
    if(DEFINED CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES)
        set(_dxx_skip_install_rules_was_defined TRUE)
        set(_dxx_skip_install_rules_saved "${CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES}")
    endif()
    set(CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES TRUE)
    set(BUILD_CXXLIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BUILD_PROGRAMS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BUILD_DOCS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(INSTALL_MANPAGES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(INSTALL_PKGCONFIG_MODULES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(INSTALL_CMAKE_CONFIG_MODULE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(WITH_OGG ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory(
        "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/libflac/src/1.5.0-5ec0185c23"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/libflac"
        EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
    )
    set(BUILD_LIBOUT123 OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BUILD_PROGRAMS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory(
        "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/mpg123/src/-0c4df83a5c/ports/cmake"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mpg123"
        EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
    )
    target_include_directories(libmpg123 INTERFACE
        "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/mpg123/src/-0c4df83a5c/src/include>"
    )
    if(_dxx_skip_install_rules_was_defined)
        set(CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES "${_dxx_skip_install_rules_saved}")
    else()
        unset(CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES)
    endif()
    cmake_policy(POP)
    dxx_add_target_alias(thirdparty::vorbis vorbis)
    dxx_add_target_alias(thirdparty::vorbisfile vorbisfile)
    dxx_add_target_alias(thirdparty::flac FLAC)
    dxx_add_target_alias(thirdparty::mpg123 libmpg123)
    if(_dxx_build_shared_libs_was_defined)
        set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS "${_dxx_build_shared_libs_saved}")
    else()
        unset(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
    endif()

    # SDL_mixer 1.2 is intentionally built from the vendored sources.  The
    # old project wrapper used global definitions and hard-coded SDL paths;
    # this target keeps all of those details local and links codec packages as
    # normal CMake targets, all built from the bundled codec sources.

    file(GLOB DXX_SDL_MIXER_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/sdl-mixer-master/SDL/[delmw]*.c"
    )
    add_library(dxx_sdl_mixer STATIC ${DXX_SDL_MIXER_SOURCES})
    target_compile_definitions(dxx_sdl_mixer PRIVATE
        WAV_MUSIC OGG_MUSIC MP3_MUSIC FLAC_MUSIC
    )
    target_include_directories(dxx_sdl_mixer
        PRIVATE "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/sdl-mixer-master/SDL"
        PUBLIC "${DXX_THIRDPARTY_ROOT}/sdl-mixer-master/SDL"
    )
    target_link_libraries(dxx_sdl_mixer
        PUBLIC thirdparty::sdl
        PRIVATE
            thirdparty::vorbisfile
            thirdparty::flac
            thirdparty::mpg123
    )
    dxx_add_target_alias(thirdparty::sdl_mixer dxx_sdl_mixer)
endif()

foreach(_dxx_required_target IN ITEMS
        thirdparty::sdl
        thirdparty::physfs)
    if(NOT TARGET "${_dxx_required_target}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Bundled dependency target ${_dxx_required_target} was not created")
    endif()
endforeach()

# ============================================================================
# 📦 SLIKENET SANDBOX MODERN STATIC ARCHIVE COMPILATION ब्लू प्रिंट
# ============================================================================
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(SLikeNetIsolated C CXX)

# 1. Enforce strict modern C++17 architectural rules across all object modules
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# 2. Universal compilation flags to bypass legacy multi-media loops safely
add_definitions(
    -D_RAKNET_SUPPORT_TCPInterface=1
    -D_RAKNET_SUPPORT_PacketLogger=0
    -D_RAKNET_SUPPORT_EmailSender=0
    -D_RAKNET_SUPPORT_HTTPConnection=0
)

# 3. Explicit Source File Intake Matrix (The 114 object modules core layout)
file(GLOB SLIKENET_CORE_SOURCES
    "SLikeNet/Source/src/*.cpp"
    "SLikeNet/Source/src/*.c"
)

# 4. Explicit Header Allocation Lookup Paths
set(SLIKENET_INCLUDE_DIRS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/SLikeNet/Source/include"
)

# 5. Build the pure isolated static library target signature layout
add_library(slikenet_modern STATIC ${SLIKENET_CORE_SOURCES})

# 6. Bind the search paths natively to the compiled target frame properties
target_include_directories(slikenet_modern 
    PUBLIC 
    ${SLIKENET_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)

# 7. Match include directories cleanly for downstream main compilation links
target_include_directories(slikenet_modern 
    INTERFACE 
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/SLikeNet/Source/include"
)

if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(slikenet_modern PUBLIC ws2_32 iphlpapi)
else()
    target_link_libraries(slikenet_modern PUBLIC pthread)
endif()
